title: Назначение файла
summary: QA-правила ручного и автоматического тестирования сайта: гейты (astro check, lint, vitest), сценарии формы, 152-ФЗ, доступность.
notes: No ADR/PRD hallmarks. Contains concrete verification gates and test scenarios (process contract for QA) but no endpoint/schema/API contracts; classified as runbook-style DOC (context/process rules). If the manifest prefers gating rules as SPEC constraints, override to SPEC is defensible.
